description.value: The original Café du Soleil has anchored Commercial Drive since 1992, making it one of the oldest cafés on Vancouver's most cycling-friendly corridor. It is a cozy, fully licensed bistro with just seven tables and bar seating, emphasizing organic, locally sourced, plant-based vegan and vegetarian West Coast cuisine. Its no-reservations, first-come policy and small group cap of four make it an intimate drop-in stop for cyclists riding through the Grandview Woodlands neighbourhood.
